exit_codes.0: all checks ok; recomputed census_hash matches
exit_codes.1: verification failure; report.errors name the failing check
exit_codes.2: usage or environment (missing git, bad repo, unreadable artifact)

outputs.stdout: census-check/1 JSON report with per-check {id, ok, detail}, errors, census_hash, recomputed_census_hash and an informational observations block (declared vs current repo/head_oid/worktree_dirty)

params.description: changed-range-census/1 artifact to verify (canonical bytes required)
params.name: --census

params.name: --repo

params.name: --scratch

check.summary: Recompute the census in a fresh temp scratch with the pinned recipe and compare census_hash (canonical payload minus the environment-varying identity observations), counts and partition; repo OIDs must still resolve and the git version must match

exit_codes.1: extraction/partition failure; artifact written with partition.ok=false and actionable errors
exit_codes.2: usage or environment (missing git, bad repo/ref, scratch inside the repo)

outputs.--out: changed-range-census/1 canonical JSON, no trailing newline
outputs.stdout: JSON summary with census_hash, counts, partition.ok, out and scratch

params.description: subject git repository (read-only; scratch must be outside it)
params.name: --repo

params.description: base ref; resolved with git rev-parse --verify <ref>^{commit}
params.name: --base

params.description: subject ref; resolved with git rev-parse --verify <ref>^{commit}
params.name: --subject

params.description: canonical changed-range-census/1 JSON output path (no trailing newline)
params.name: --out

params.description: raw stream scratch dir (default: fresh temp dir outside the repo)
params.name: --scratch

run.summary: Run the pinned two-dot diff recipe and write the canonical changed-range-census/1 artifact
run.usage: census run --repo PATH --base REF --subject REF --out CENSUS.json [--scratch DIR]

determinism.notes: census_hash binds base/subject OIDs, refs, recipe, files, parents, events, counts and partition and is identical for the same repo state and git version; the environment-varying identity observations (repo path, HEAD, worktree dirtiness) are recorded for audit but excluded from the hash

exit_codes.1: semantic or validation failure; read report.errors (each names the exact unit_id/field/check)
exit_codes.2: usage or environment failure (bad arguments, missing/wrong pinned dependency)

name: census

recipe_pins.stat: git -C repo -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --stat --no-renames --ignore-submodules=none <base_oid>..<subject_oid>  # orientation only, never the denominator

summary: Deterministic changed-range census (changed-range-census/1) over base..subject with a pinned two-dot git-diff recipe; parents are -U0 edit blocks, metadata changes are events, and every stream is reconciled in a partition check
